expectations.text: Reads the form-B pass-rate jump against a flat form A as the first leak signal, or as tasks now solvable unattended by agents, rather than as improved candidates.
expectations.evidence: 'Form A flat at about 60% is the best clue'; candidate causes include a leak and 'Agents solving the tasks unattended'.

expectations.text: Follows the incident runbook in order: detect, contain, investigate, decide, recover, record.
expectations.evidence: Contain and investigate come first, then decide and recover by cause, but there is no record step.

expectations.text: Contains by pulling form B and switching to reserve forms before investigating.
expectations.evidence: 'Take form B out of live use and serve form A or a reserve form.'

expectations.text: Investigates with item exposure data and candidate statements before any sanction.
expectations.evidence: 'pass rate per task variant and per task'; 'Leave all badges untouched until the checks above are done.'

expectations.text: Rejects the blanket reset of every Q3 form-B pass; revokes only per the candidate agreement, with an appeals path.
expectations.evidence: 'Don't reset them... Revoke only on proven grounds... individually, with notice and appeal.'

expectations.text: Names proxy sitting as the threat because the reseller partners pay for seats, and counters it with spot live verification or a short defence on a sample of passes.
expectations.evidence: 'Your partner tier pays for seats, so one strong engineer sitting for colleagues is the named threat'; '15-minute live call'.

expectations.text: Rejects switching to proctored multiple-choice, stating that recall items are what assistants answer best and what leaks worst.
expectations.evidence: 'Recall is what assistants answer best.'

expectations.text: Rejects the strict no-AI rule for an unproctored sitting because it cannot be detected, and offers the 'allowed' policy with a human-attributable step instead.
expectations.evidence: 'A strict no-AI rule can't be enforced'; 'allow them and reword the claim as "works competently with their own tools"'. Adds the live explanation step.

expectations.text: Keeps the hands-on format and adds a sampled live or recorded explanation announced in the candidate agreement.
expectations.evidence: 'Keep the hands-on format'; the sampled live-explanation clause is checked in the agreement and added for new sittings.

expectations.text: Recovers by writing replacement task variants, re-equating, and filing takedown requests if a dump site is found.
expectations.evidence: It covers rotating variants and re-equating, but no takedown requests for dump sites.

expectations.text: Adds item exposure analysis as a standing control: retire tasks whose success rate jumps, and monitor pass rate per item and per form.
expectations.evidence: 'add item-exposure monitoring'; 'rotate variants, retire the exposed tasks'.

expectations.text: Records what changed so the next leak is caught sooner.
expectations.evidence: It freezes logs for the investigation, but there is no record or lessons-learned step.
